resources.string: LSPosed sees SwiftSlate, but no keyboard has loaded it yet. In LSPosed, add your keyboard to SwiftSlate\'s scope, then force-stop the keyboard (or reboot).
Enable the SwiftSlate module in LSPosed, add your keyboard to its scope, then restart the keyboard. The accessibility service is no longer needed.
Keep earlier messages of this command and send them with each new one, like a chat. Stored only on this device.
Treat your text as a question and answer it using Google Search (time in another city, news, weather, scores). Gemini provider only; counts toward your Gemini quota.

Lets Gemini look things up on Google in every AI command. Rewrite commands (?fix, ?improve…) still just rewrite your text, so for questions use the ?ask command or switch on "Answer with live web search" for a command. Gemini provider only; counts toward your Gemini quota.
